item.title: Life difficult in Russian-run regions of Ukraine
item.description: TALLINN, Estonia — Nearly four years into its full-scale invasion, Russia controls about 20 percent of Ukrainian territory. Many of the estimated 3 million to 5 million people who remain in regions under Moscow’s control face housing, water, power, heat and health care woes.

item.title: 2A District Girls Basketball: Resilient Ridgefield wins third straight elimination game to reach 2A state tournament
item.description: A fourth-place finish in the 2A Greater St. Helens League left the Ridgefield girls basketball team with long odds to earn one of three 2A state berths in the District 4 tournament. But the Spudders are a tough team to bet against come playoff time, as they've proven in each of the last two seasons.
